title: EMD Electronics Announces $1 Billion Investment in US to Support Semiconductor Customers
主要内容: EMD Electronics, the North American Electronics business of Merck KGaA, announced a $1 billion investment in the US through 2025 to accelerate growth opportunities in the electronics market. The investment is part of the "Level Up" growth program, which includes a global investment of significantly more than $3.5 billion. The company plans to spend around $2.5 billion globally in long-term fixed assets (CapEx) in Semiconductor and Display Solutions. The investment aims to expand production capacity and innovation footprint to support customers' growth plans. The demand for innovative semiconductor and display materials is driven by exponential data growth and technology trends such as AI, IoT, and 5G.
